title: Joints and Terminations of Polymeric Cables for Working Voltages from 66kV Up To and Including 33 kV - Performance Requirements and Type Test
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 1) details the performance requirements and the test methods for type tests for cable accessories for use on cables of rated voltage from 1.1 kV to 3.3 kV(E). Once the accessories have been successfully type tested, then these tests need not be repeated unless changes are made in the cable accessory materials, design or manufacturing process which might affect the performance characteristics. Joints, indoor and outdoor terminations for extruded solid dielectric insulated cables are included. The service operating conditions of accessories shall be compatible with the service operating conditions of the cable.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
